risk_summary: The disclosure is broadly quantitative and transparent, reporting sales, margins, liquidity, borrowing capacity, and impairment-test results. It acknowledges material risks from inflation, supply-chain disruptions, geopolitical conflict, labor shortages, and COVID-19, while using moderately reassuring forward-looking language regarding liquidity and mitigation efforts. Complex accounting terminology and extensive conditional language somewhat reduce accessibility but do not appear strongly evasive.
